rules.photometry: Only exactly compatible photometry (same epoch, band, system, method, calibration and direct/difference state, two or more providers) is compared. rules.revision: A retracted row, or a superseded row of the same provider whose value differs beyond the property's rule, is a revision or retraction; a revision within the rule is consistent; the earlier value stays visible.
rules.sigma: Two values that both state an uncertainty are inconsistent when they differ by more than 3 combined standard deviations (uncertainties added in quadrature; a stated position error radius is treated as one standard deviation).
